rules: One paid entry per participant. Entries are personal and can't be shared.

privacy: DES uses these details only to run OPEN CITY 2027: to confirm your entry, contact you about the competition and report totals to sponsors. They are not sold or shared with judges. Email us to have them corrected or deleted.

intro: OPEN CITY is the Design Student Society's flagship competition, and the biggest design student competition in Australia: one shared challenge facing Melbourne, taken on by students from three design disciplines over the summer break.
Enter on your own or in a team of up to three. Twelve finalists present at the final exhibition and awards in March 2027, with $3,500 in cash prizes to be won.

facts.label: Biggest design student competition in Australia

landing.locked: The full brief and each category brief are published here on 27 November 2026, free for everyone to read.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Enter your email, open the link we send you, and fill in a two-minute form: name, university, category, Discord.

steps.title: Pay your entry
steps.text: Each participant pays for their own entry, securely by card.

steps.title: Join the Discord
steps.text: Announcements, questions, mentor videos and the team-finder open up as soon as payment is confirmed.

steps.title: Solo or team
steps.text: Enter alone, register your team of two or three, or find teammates in the Discord team-finder and form a team afterwards.

steps.title: Design and submit
steps.text: Registration closes 23 December 2026. Round 1 submissions close 29 January 2027, and judging is anonymous.

faq.a: No. You can enter individually, or in a team of two or three.

faq.q: I do not have teammates yet. Can I still register?
faq.a: Yes. Register and pay as “looking for teammates”, then use the team-finder on the DES Discord, which opens once your entry is paid. When you have a team, one member registers it and invites the others. You will not need to register again.

faq.q: Does one person pay for the whole team?
faq.a: No. Each member pays for their own entry from their own registration. The team leader then registers the team and each member confirms.

faq.q: Can I be in more than one team?
faq.a: No. One entry per person, and one team per person.

faq.q: When do I see the brief?
faq.a: It is published on this page on 27 November 2026, free for everyone to read. You do not need to register or pay to see it.

faq.q: What if the entry fee is a barrier?
faq.a: Confidential fee waivers are available. Email DES before registration closes on 23 December 2026.

faq.q: Do I need to be a DES member, or study at the University of Melbourne?
faq.a: No. OPEN CITY is open to Bachelor's and Master's coursework students at any university or higher education provider in Victoria.
